- The "pocket walls" were the player's own black halo/outline! Player sprite = 5-wide × 5-tall black outline (rows 37-41) around a 3×4 blue/yellow body. The halo moved with the player in the diff.
- Player is NOT trapped. LEFT/RIGHT slide player horizontally until the halo hits a real wall.
- Player sits at the TOP of the bottom S-region (region top = row 37, player halo top = row 37). Hypothesis: player is "stuck to the top of the S-region in its column" → sliding into shaft cols (47-51) should make it jump UP into the middle band (rows 19-30).
- Goal hypothesis: reach top-right S-region (exit) by going up the shaft, then through/breaking the green-block wall band (rows 12-18, cols 32-53).
- Plan: slide RIGHT and watch the player's row when it crosses the shaft.

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def player_pos(fr):
    # find blue body node
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']<20:
            rows=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cols=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
    return None
p0=player_pos(current_frame)
r=action(['RIGHT'])
p1=player_pos(current_frame)
print('before',p0,'after',p1)
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','no_impact','done','level_completed','game_over','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
